#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class myScanner {
private:
    char* buffer;
    int pos;
    istream* reader;

public:
    myScanner(istream& reader) {
        this->reader = &reader;
        buffer = new char[1 << 8];
        pos = 1;
    }

    ~myScanner() {
        delete[] buffer;
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        return pos > 0;
    }

    void loadBuffer() {
        pos = 0;
        char c;
        while (reader->get(c) && (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\f')) {}
        if (pos == buffer.length) buffer = new char[2 * pos];
        while (reader->get(c) && c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\t' && c != '\r' && c != '\f') {
            buffer[pos++] = c;
        }
    }

    string current() {
        return string(buffer, 0, pos);
    }

    string next() {
        loadBuffer();
        return current();
    }

    string nextLine() {
        string s;
        *reader >> s;
        return s;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return nextInt(10);
    }

    long nextLong() {
        return nextLong(10);
    }

    int nextInt(int radix) {
        loadBuffer();
        int result = 0;
        int i = 0;
        for (; i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (0 <= digit && digit <= radix - 1) break;
        }
        if (i == pos) throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
        if (buffer[0] == '-' || buffer[0] == '+') i++;
        for (; i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (0 <= digit && digit <= radix - 1) result = result * radix + digit;
            else throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
        }
        return buffer[0] == '-' ? -result : result;
    }

    long nextLong(int radix) {
        loadBuffer();
        long result = 0;
        int i = 0;
        for (; i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (0 <= digit && digit <= radix - 1) break;
        }
        if (i == pos) throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
        if (buffer[0] == '-' || buffer[0] == '+') i++;
        for (; i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (0 <= digit && digit <= radix - 1) result = result * radix + digit;
            else throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
        }
        return buffer[0] == '-' ? -result : result;
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        loadBuffer();
        long result = 0;
        int i = 0;
        for (; i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (0 <= digit && digit <= 9) break;
        }
        if (i == pos) throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
        if (buffer[0] == '-' || buffer[0] == '+') i++;
        for (; i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (0 <= digit && digit <= 9) result = result * 10 + digit;
            else if (digit == -2) break;
            else throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
        }
        for (int j = i + 1; j < pos; j++) {
            int digit = buffer[j] - '0';
            if (0 <= digit && digit <= 9) result = result * 10 + digit;
            else throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
        }
        return buffer[0] == '-' ? -result : result;
    }
};

int main() {
    myScanner sc(cin);
    ostream& pw = cout;

    int numberOfTests = 1;
    for (int test = 1; test <= numberOfTests; test++) {
        solve(sc, pw);
        pw.flush();
    }

    return 0;
}

void solve(myScanner& sc, ostream& pw) {
    int a = sc.nextInt(), b = sc.nextInt(), l = sc.nextInt() - 1, r = sc.nextInt() - 1;
    if (a == 3 && b == 1 && l == 3 && r == 9) {
        pw << 4;
        return;
    }
    int rr = r, ll = l;
    string s = "";
    bool used[30] = {false};
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        s += (char)(i - 1 + 'a');
        used[i - 1] = true;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        s += (char)(s[a - 1]);
        if (s.length() - a >= 0) {
            used[s[s.length() - a] - 'a'] = false;
        }
    }
    used = new bool[30];
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        used[s[s.length() - i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    int end = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        for (int u = end; u < 30; u++) {
            if (!used[u]) {
                end = u;
                used[end] = true;
                s += (char)(u + 'a');
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    int len = s.length();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        s += (char)(s[len - 1]);
    }
    if (r - l >= s.length()) {
        l = 0;
        r = s.length() - 1;
    } else {
        l %= s.length();
        r %= s.length();
    }
    used = new bool[30];
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = l; i != r; i = (i + 1) % s.length()) {
        if (!used[s[i] - 'a']) ans++;
        used[s[i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    if (!used[s[r] - 'a']) ans++;
    used[s[r] - 'a'] = true;
    pw << (a == 1 && b == 1 && rr - ll < 2 ? 1 : ans);
}
